paid_source_surplus.statement: With S=(37I/40+3B/40)^(-1), C=Cov(F), D=S^(1/2) C S^(1/2), retain G=tr(D)-logdet(D)-m. Then 2delta >= G + ||gradient Y||_2^2/1000 + Omega_B/1000.
paid_source_surplus.reason: The logdet supporting-plane gap is exactly G. Carry it as an additional negative constant through the source subsequent inequalities. Retain the already-documented exact chaos coefficients k_d >=d/1000. No new upstream assertion is needed.

parent_normalization_lemma.hypotheses: X centered isotropic; P symmetric positive definite; F centered Gaussian transport with law PX; C=P^2; S any positive definite matrix. All dimensions finite.
parent_normalization_lemma.construction: Under the source transport coupling set X=P^(-1)F, D=S^(1/2) C S^(1/2), Q=D^(-1/2) S^(1/2)P. Then QQ*=I, so Q is orthogonal, and S^(1/2)F=D^(1/2)QX.
parent_normalization_lemma.bound: For t>0, (sqrt(t)-1)^2 <= t-1-log(t), since the difference equals 2(sqrt(t)-1-log(sqrt(t))) >=0. Thus this cost <=G<=2delta.
parent_normalization_lemma.limits: No inverse-norm bound, commutation of S and C, or exceptional-direction deletion is used. The coupling preserves the arbitrary dependence of X coordinates. This is an elementary matrix normalization consequence, not a separately nominated substantial result.

weighted_remainder.statement: With J=q(A), L first chaos and A=L+Y, E||S^(1/2)(J-q(L))||F^2 <=(40/37)||Y||_2^2 <=(40000/37)delta. S^(1/2)J is the weak Jacobian of S^(1/2)F under output-row convention.
weighted_remainder.limits: S need not commute with q(L). This zeroth-order inequality supplies no dimension-free derivative estimate automatically; Duhamel factors may rotate the weight. A Gaussian primitive/product-factor approximation is still required.
